name: Germany: freelancers (Freiberufler) and sole traders
dueNote: VAT returns (Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung) are due on the 10th day after each month or quarter, and income-tax prepayments on 10 March, June, September and December; pay them from the vault as they fall due. The rest of a year's reserve is released about ten months after the year ends, after the annual return and assessment.

notes: Solidarity surcharge and church tax are not included; pension insurance is voluntary for most freelancers. Health insurance is treated as fully deductible.
Income tax is progressive (up to 45%) plus solidarity surcharge and, if applicable, church tax; 30% of the base is a suggested reserve, not a calculation.
Rule packs are information, not tax advice. The user confirms the percentages; the vault enforces what the user chose.
